title: Study of the future offshore-chain of survival
summary: Untersuchung der Offshore-Rettungskette in ihrer Funktionalität und Identifikation potentieller Mängel. Desweiteren Entwicklung von Konzepten als Vorschlag zur zukünftigen Aufstellung einer Offshore-Rettungskette

interventions.name:
Observational study, non-interventional:
Literature search, restrospektive analysis of field data, structured interviews of staff and developer as well as anonymous questionaires to offshore workers to examine the quality of the offshore-chain of survival in the North Sea.
Data recruitment: 12/202

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Offshore worker
Designer and personnel of the offshore-chain of survival
Adult
Informed consent (Interviews)
Exclusion criteria:
Non-adult
Denial of informed consent (Interview)
